# Notebook 40 -- Aggregate raw CMIP6 **SSP** runs to catchment means

**What this notebook does.** The SSP-era twin of `QED_05_aggregate_cmip6.Rmd`
(which stays untouched -- new modules are parallel, never invasive). It turns
the raw CMIP6 scenario NetCDF daily files into wide catchment-mean CSVs that
the SSP quantile-mapping notebook (`QED_50_ssp_apply.Rmd`, to be written) will
read:

* input dir: the SSP download root, **searched recursively** so that either
  layout works -- the original flat `data_raw/cmip6/` and the
  variable-major layout `Download_CMIP/SSP/<var>/` adopted on 20 Nov 2026
  (`download_cmip6_ssp.R` now downloads one variable at a time into its own
  folder). Same naming convention in both:
  `<var>_day_<model>_<ssp>_<member>_<grid>_<year>_v<ver>.nc` -- the variable
  is taken from the filename, never from the folder, so a mis-filed download
  cannot be silently mis-aggregated;
* models: the **14 hybrid-shortlisted** models from
  `data_processed/hyd/model_shortlist_final.csv` (`selected == 1`) --
  NOT all 22 historical models (the selection is already done);
* scenarios: **ssp126, ssp245, ssp370, ssp585** (AR6 core matrix; ssp370 added
  18 Nov 2026 for drought-envelope completeness and CAMELS-IND-Proj
  comparability);
* windows: near 2015-2040, mid 2041-2060, long 2081-2100 (the download plan).
  **The gap years 2061-2080 were never downloaded by design**, so the output
  columns cover only the three windows; the gap is logged, never hidden;
* output layout: one CSV per model x ssp x variable
  (`data_processed/ssp/agg_<var>_<model>_<ssp>.csv`), first column `id`
  (5-digit gauge ids), remaining columns one calendar day
  `YYYYMMDD` (24,206 window days), one row per catchment (472);
* everything else identical to QED_05: cell-area-weighted catchment means
  (cos-lat), pr kg m-2 s-1 -> mm/day, tas K -> degC, 365-day calendars mapped
  by `terra::time()` (Feb 29 -> NA), the 360-day calendar of HadGEM3-GC31-MM
  mapped day 1..30 of each real month (invalid dates -> NA).

**Design decisions pre-registered here (18 Nov 2026):**

1. SSP aggregation reads from the download root directly -- no copying of
   bulk nc files into the repo.
2. Agg CSVs land in `data_processed/ssp/`, a directory QED_05 never touches
   (its stale-file cleanup in `data_processed/` would otherwise delete them).
3. EQM for the SSP leg will be fitted on the **full historical 1981-2014**
   (observed CAMELS forcings vs each model's historical run) and applied to
   the SSP series with `pr` tail policy **"linear"** (constant clamping would
   truncate intensified future rainfall extremes; this was already the
   recommendation in the download script header). The out-of-sample
   fit-1981-2000/score-2001-2014 discipline belongs to model *ranking*
   (QED_20/30), not to projection *application*; this is stated here so the
   choice is dated and reviewable.
4. Every missing model x ssp x variable combo (or missing year inside a
   combo) gets a log line AND a row in
   `data_processed/logs/QED_40_ssp_exclusions.csv` -- no silent drops.

**Incremental-run rules (added 20 Nov 2026, while the SSP download is still in
progress).** The notebook is now safe to run at any point before the grid is
complete, and it is idempotent:

5. **A combo is aggregated only when all 66 window years are present**
   (`qed_ssp_min_years`). A half-downloaded combo would otherwise produce a
   CSV whose missing windows are NA, and NA-window low-flow metrics are not
   low-flow metrics. Incomplete combos are logged with their year count and
   skipped; the next run picks them up when they finish. `QED_50` already
   degrades to `skipped_ssp_agg_missing`, so no downstream module needs to
   change.
6. **Every input file is validated by magic bytes before `terra::rast()`.** On
   19-20 Nov 2026 several ESGF THREDDS nodes returned a Java stack trace
   (`StorageExceptionNotActive`) as the HTTP body; the downloader wrote it to
   disk as `<name>.nc`. A real netCDF-4/HDF5 file starts with
   `89 48 44 46 0D 0A 1A 0A`, netCDF-3 classic with `CDF\x01`. Anything else
   is an error page and is excluded with reason `not_netcdf_error_page` --
   it must never reach `terra` and must never look like a missing year.

```{r log-file}
qed_ssp_agg_dir <- file.path(qed_project_root, "data_processed", "ssp")
dir.create(qed_ssp_agg_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
qed_ssp_log_file <- file.path(qed_ssp_agg_dir, "qed_40_log.txt")
```

## 1. SSP configuration

```{r ssp-config}
# Raw nc roots, searched recursively in order. The variable-major layout
# (Download_CMIP/SSP/<var>/) replaced the flat data_raw/cmip6/ root on
# 20 Nov 2026; both are accepted so an in-flight reorganisation cannot break
# the notebook.
qed_ssp_raw_roots <- c("D:/Datasets/Download_CMIP/SSP",
                       "D:/Datasets/Download_CMIP/data_raw/cmip6")
qed_ssp_raw_roots <- qed_ssp_raw_roots[dir.exists(qed_ssp_raw_roots)]
stopifnot(length(qed_ssp_raw_roots) > 0)

# Scenarios: AR6 core matrix
qed_ssp_list <- c("ssp126", "ssp245", "ssp370", "ssp585")

# Analysis windows (must mirror time_windows in download_cmip6_ssp.R)
qed_ssp_windows <- list(
   near = c(as.Date("2015-01-01"), as.Date("2040-12-31")),
   mid  = c(as.Date("2041-01-01"), as.Date("2060-12-31")),
   long = c(as.Date("2081-01-01"), as.Date("2100-12-31"))
)

# Smoke-test mode: 1 model x 1 ssp x 10 catchments. FALSE for production.
qed_ssp_test_mode <- FALSE

# Completeness gate (rule 5): a combo is aggregated only with all 66 years.
qed_ssp_min_years <- 66L
```

```{r ssp-model-list}
shortlist <- data.table::fread(file.path(qed_project_root, "data_processed",
                                         "hyd", "model_shortlist_final.csv"))
models_ssp <- shortlist[selected == 1, model]
stopifnot(length(models_ssp) == 14)   # guard: the hybrid shortlist is fixed
cat("Shortlisted models:", length(models_ssp), "\n")
cat(paste(models_ssp, collapse = ", "), "\n")
```

## 2. Daily column grid for the three windows

```{r grid}
# Full daily index per window, then concatenated (the 2061-2080 gap stays out)
window_dates <- lapply(qed_ssp_windows, function(w) seq(w[1], w[2], by = "day"))
ssp_dates    <- do.call(c, unname(window_dates))
ssp_cols     <- format(ssp_dates, "%Y%m%d")
n_days_ssp   <- length(ssp_cols)

# sanity: expected window sizes (26 y incl 7 leap = 9497 | 20 y incl 5 leap =
# 7305 | 20 y incl 4 leap = 7304)
stopifnot(length(window_dates$near) == 9497,
          length(window_dates$mid)  == 7305,
          length(window_dates$long) == 7304)
cat("SSP grid:", n_days_ssp, "window days (gap 2061-2080 excluded by design)\n")
```

## 3. Discover SSP files in the raw archive

```{r discover}
# Files land as <var>_day_<model>_<ssp>_<member>_<grid>_<year>_v<ver>.nc,
# either flat or under a per-variable folder -- search recursively.
# token 3 = model, token 4 = ssp, year from the _YYYY_v pattern (as in QED_05)
fl <- unlist(lapply(qed_ssp_raw_roots, function(d)
   list.files(d, pattern = "_day_.*_ssp[0-9]+_.*\\.nc$", full.names = TRUE,
              recursive = TRUE)))
fl <- unique(fl)
stopifnot(length(fl) > 0)
cat("raw SSP nc files found under", length(qed_ssp_raw_roots), "root(s):",
    length(fl), "\n")

tok  <- strsplit(basename(fl), "_")
var_of   <- vapply(tok, `[`, character(1), 1)
model_of <- vapply(tok, `[`, character(1), 3)
ssp_of   <- vapply(tok, `[`, character(1), 4)
year_of  <- as.integer(sub("^.*_([0-9]{4})_v.*$", "\\1", basename(fl)))

# ---- magic-byte validation (rule 6): an ESGF error page is not a year ------
# HDF5 magic (netCDF-4) = 89 48 44 46 0D 0A 1A 0A ; netCDF-3 classic = CDF\x01
HDF5_MAGIC <- as.raw(c(0x89, 0x48, 0x44, 0x46, 0x0D, 0x0A, 0x1A, 0x0A))
CDF1_MAGIC <- as.raw(c(0x43, 0x44, 0x46, 0x01))
is_nc <- vapply(fl, function(f) {
   h <- tryCatch(readBin(f, what = "raw", n = 8L), error = function(e) raw(0))
   (length(h) >= 8L && identical(h[1:8], HDF5_MAGIC)) ||
      (length(h) >= 4L && identical(h[1:4], CDF1_MAGIC))
}, logical(1))
if (any(!is_nc)) {
   bad <- data.table::data.table(
      module = "QED_40", catchment = NA_character_,
      reason_code = "not_netcdf_error_page",
      detail = paste0(basename(fl[!is_nc]), "|",
                      file.size(fl[!is_nc]), "B"))
   qed_log(paste("EXCLUDED", sum(!is_nc),
                 "files that are not netCDF (ESGF error pages, not data)"),
           qed_ssp_log_file)
   fl <- fl[is_nc]; var_of <- var_of[is_nc]; model_of <- model_of[is_nc]
   ssp_of <- ssp_of[is_nc]; year_of <- year_of[is_nc]
} else {
   bad <- NULL
}

# keep only our variables and shortlisted models x scenarios
keep <- var_of %in% qed_vars & model_of %in% models_ssp & ssp_of %in% qed_ssp_list
extra_models <- setdiff(unique(model_of[var_of %in% qed_vars &
                                        ssp_of %in% qed_ssp_list]), models_ssp)
if (length(extra_models)) {
   qed_log(paste("NOTE: non-shortlist models present on disk and ignored:",
                 paste(sort(extra_models), collapse = ", ")), qed_ssp_log_file)
   cat("Non-shortlist models on disk (ignored by design):",
       paste(sort(extra_models), collapse = ", "), "\n")
}
fl   <- fl[keep]
var_of <- var_of[keep]; model_of <- model_of[keep]
ssp_of <- ssp_of[keep]; year_of <- year_of[keep]
cat(length(fl), "SSP nc files on disk for the", length(models_ssp), "x",
    length(qed_ssp_list), "shortlist grid\n")

# what is present vs expected (14 models x 4 ssps x 3 vars x 66 years)
expected_years <- sort(unique(unlist(lapply(qed_ssp_windows,
   function(w) as.integer(format(w[1], "%Y")):as.integer(format(w[2], "%Y"))))))
# Explicit "var|model|ssp" key: split() would join the three factors with "."
# by default, which never matches the "|" key used below -- that mismatch made
# the aggregate loop skip every combo on the first run (0 files written).
combo_key <- paste(var_of, model_of, ssp_of, sep = "|")
ssp_files <- split(seq_along(fl), combo_key)

# ---- per-combo status table (rule 5) + exclusions log ----------------------
# One row per expected combo, always written: this is the download tracker.
have_combo <- combo_key
status_rows <- list(); excl <- list()
if (!is.null(bad)) excl[[length(excl) + 1L]] <- bad
for (v in qed_vars) for (m in models_ssp) for (s in qed_ssp_list) {
   key <- paste(v, m, s, sep = "|")
   yrs_here <- unique(year_of[have_combo == key])
   yrs_here <- yrs_here[yrs_here %in% expected_years]
   miss <- setdiff(expected_years, yrs_here)
   status_rows[[length(status_rows) + 1L]] <- data.table::data.table(
      var = v, model = m, ssp = s,
      n_years = length(yrs_here), n_expected = length(expected_years),
      complete = length(yrs_here) >= qed_ssp_min_years)
   if (length(yrs_here) == 0) {
      excl[[length(excl) + 1L]] <- data.table::data.table(
         module = "QED_40", catchment = NA_character_,
         reason_code = "combo_absent", detail = key,
         n_missing_years = length(expected_years))
   } else if (length(miss)) {
      excl[[length(excl) + 1L]] <- data.table::data.table(
         module = "QED_40", catchment = NA_character_,
         reason_code = "years_missing",
         detail = paste0(key, "|years:", paste(miss, collapse = ";")),
         n_missing_years = length(miss))
   }
}
ssp_combo_status <- data.table::rbindlist(status_rows)
data.table::fwrite(ssp_combo_status,
                   file.path(qed_ssp_agg_dir, "qed_40_combo_status.csv"))
cat("Combos complete:", sum(ssp_combo_status$complete), "of",
    nrow(ssp_combo_status), "| files still missing:",
    sum(ssp_combo_status$n_expected - ssp_combo_status$n_years), "\n")
print(ssp_combo_status[, .(complete = sum(complete), combos = .N),
                       by = var])

excl_dt <- data.table::rbindlist(excl, use.names = TRUE, fill = TRUE)
if (nrow(excl_dt)) {
   data.table::fwrite(excl_dt,
                      file.path(qed_project_root, "data_processed", "logs",
                                "QED_40_ssp_exclusions.csv"))
   cat("Logged exclusions:", nrow(excl_dt),
       "(data_processed/logs/QED_40_ssp_exclusions.csv)\n")
} else {
   cat("No missing combos or years -- full grid on disk\n")
}
```

## 4. Catchment polygons (read once)

```{r polygons}
polys <- sf::st_as_sf(terra::vect(file.path(qed_project_root, "data_raw",
                                            "catchments", "merged",
                                            "all_catchments.shp")))
polys$id <- qed_normalize_id(polys$gauge_id)
n_polys <- nrow(polys)
if (qed_ssp_test_mode) polys <- polys[1:10, ]
cat("Polygons:", n_polys, "\n")
```

## 5. Date mapping helper (handles the 360-day calendar)

Identical to QED_05 -- repeated here so this notebook stays self-contained
without sourcing an existing notebook.

```{r date-helper}
qed_ssp_nc_dates <- function(r, year) {
   nl <- terra::nlyr(r)
   if (nl == 360) {
      m <- (seq_len(nl) - 1L) %/% 30L + 1L
      d <- (seq_len(nl) - 1L) %% 30L + 1L
      dt <- as.Date(sprintf("%04d-%02d-%02d", year, m, d))  # Feb 30 -> NA
   } else {
      dt <- as.Date(terra::time(r))
   }
   dt
}
```

## 6. Aggregate: one pass per model x ssp x variable

```{r aggregate, eval=TRUE}
unit_scale  <- c(pr = 86400, tasmax = -273.15, tasmin = -273.15)
unit_is_add <- c(pr = FALSE, tasmax = TRUE,  tasmin = TRUE)

combos <- expand.grid(var = qed_vars, model = models_ssp,
                      ssp = qed_ssp_list, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
combos$key <- paste(combos$var, combos$model, combos$ssp, sep = "|")
# keep only combos with at least one file on disk
combos$have <- combos$key %in% names(ssp_files)
combos <- combos[combos$have, ]

# completeness gate (rule 5): aggregate only combos with all 66 years
combos$n_years <- ssp_combo_status$n_years[match(
   combos$key, paste(ssp_combo_status$var, ssp_combo_status$model,
                     ssp_combo_status$ssp, sep = "|"))]
n_incomplete <- sum(!is.na(combos$n_years) & combos$n_years < qed_ssp_min_years)
if (n_incomplete) qed_log(sprintf(
   "SKIPPED %d incomplete combos (< %d years); see qed_40_combo_status.csv",
   n_incomplete, qed_ssp_min_years), qed_ssp_log_file)
combos <- combos[!is.na(combos$n_years) & combos$n_years >= qed_ssp_min_years, ]

# incremental: a combo already aggregated is not redone (delete its CSV to
# force a rebuild). This is what makes repeated runs during the download cheap.
combos$agg_fp <- file.path(qed_ssp_agg_dir,
   sprintf("agg_%s_%s_%s.csv", combos$var, combos$model, combos$ssp))
n_done <- sum(file.exists(combos$agg_fp))
combos <- combos[!file.exists(combos$agg_fp), ]
cat("Complete combos:", nrow(combos) + n_done, "| already aggregated:",
    n_done, "| to aggregate now:", nrow(combos), "\n")

if (qed_ssp_test_mode) combos <- utils::head(combos, 1L)

# Optional cap for a smoke test without editing the notebook:
#   QED_SSP_MAX_COMBOS=2 Rscript -e "rmarkdown::render('QED_40_ssp_aggregate.Rmd')"
qed_ssp_max_combos <- as.integer(Sys.getenv("QED_SSP_MAX_COMBOS", "0"))
if (!is.na(qed_ssp_max_combos) && qed_ssp_max_combos > 0L) {
   combos <- utils::head(combos, qed_ssp_max_combos)
   cat("capped this run to", nrow(combos), "combos (QED_SSP_MAX_COMBOS)\n")
}

# ---- one combo, self-contained so a PSOCK worker can run it ---------------
# Writes the CSV itself; returns a status record (never a silent drop: a combo
# with any unreadable file is not written and reports every failing file).
agg_one_combo <- function(job) {
   out <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = nrow(polys), ncol = n_days_ssp,
                 dimnames = list(polys$id, ssp_cols))
   errs <- character(0)
   for (j in seq_along(job$files)) {
      f <- job$files[j]; yr <- job$yrs[j]
      ok <- tryCatch({
         r  <- terra::rast(f)
         dt <- qed_ssp_nc_dates(r, yr)
         w  <- cos(terra::init(r, "y") * pi / 180)      # cell-area weights
         ex <- exactextractr::exact_extract(
            r, polys, "weighted_mean", weights = w,
            stack_apply = TRUE, progress = FALSE)
         vals <- as.matrix(ex)                          # [n_polys, nl]
         vals <- if (unit_is_add[[job$var]]) vals + unit_scale[[job$var]]
                 else vals * unit_scale[[job$var]]
         idx_day <- match(format(dt, "%Y%m%d"), ssp_cols)  # NA for invalid
         keep <- !is.na(idx_day)
         out[, idx_day[keep]] <- vals[, keep, drop = FALSE]
         TRUE
      }, error = function(e) conditionMessage(e))
      if (!isTRUE(ok)) errs <- c(errs, paste0(basename(f), ": ", ok))
   }
   if (length(errs)) {
      return(list(status = "error", n_bad = length(errs),
                  detail = paste(errs, collapse = " | ")))
   }
   dt_out <- data.table::as.data.table(out)
   dt_out[, id := rownames(out)]
   data.table::setcolorder(dt_out, "id")
   data.table::fwrite(dt_out, job$agg_fp)
   list(status = "ok", n_bad = 0L, n_cov = sum(!is.na(out[1, ])),
        n_days = n_days_ssp, fp = job$agg_fp)
}

jobs <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(combos)), function(i) {
   idx   <- ssp_files[[combos$key[i]]]
   files <- sort(fl[idx]); yrs <- year_of[idx]
   keep  <- yrs %in% expected_years
   list(var = combos$var[i], model = combos$model[i], ssp = combos$ssp[i],
        files = files[keep], yrs = yrs[keep], agg_fp = combos$agg_fp[i])
})

# Sequential on purpose (measured 21 Nov 2026): 472 polygons cost 1.84 s/file,
# i.e. ~2 min per 66-year combo. A 6-worker PSOCK cluster was tried first and
# died with `std::bad_alloc` inside terra on a 15.7 GB machine (7.4 GB free),
# taking the result channel with it. Reliability beats a 3x speed-up here, and
# the skip-existing rule makes repeat runs cheap.
qed_ssp_workers <- 1L
cat("aggregation: sequential,", length(jobs), "combos\n")

results <- lapply(jobs, agg_one_combo)

for (i in seq_along(jobs)) {
   r <- results[[i]]
   if (identical(r$status, "ok")) {
      qed_log(sprintf("agg %s %s %s: %d files ok, %d/%d window days covered",
                      jobs[[i]]$var, jobs[[i]]$model, jobs[[i]]$ssp,
                      length(jobs[[i]]$files), r$n_cov, r$n_days),
              qed_ssp_log_file)
   } else {
      qed_log(paste("ERROR", jobs[[i]]$model, jobs[[i]]$ssp, jobs[[i]]$var,
                    r$detail), qed_ssp_log_file)
   }
}
cat("combos written this run:",
    sum(vapply(results, function(r) identical(r$status, "ok"), logical(1))),
    "of", length(jobs), "\n")
```

## 7. Verification

```{r verify}
made <- list.files(qed_ssp_agg_dir, pattern = "^agg_(pr|tasmax|tasmin)_.*_ssp[0-9]+\\.csv$",
                   full.names = TRUE)
if (!length(made)) {
   cat("No complete combo yet -- nothing aggregated.",
       "Progress is tracked in qed_40_combo_status.csv\n")
} else {
   base_of  <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(made))
   parts    <- strsplit(base_of, "_")   # agg, var, model..., ssp
   # model names contain "-" but not "_", ssp is the last token
   var_of2  <- vapply(parts, `[`, character(1), 2)
   ssp_of2  <- vapply(parts, `[`, character(1), length(parts[[1]]))
   model_of2 <- vapply(parts, function(p) paste(p[3:(length(p) - 1)], collapse = "_"))

   combos_made <- data.table::expand.grid(model = model_of2, ssp = ssp_of2,
                                          var = var_of2, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
   n_expected <- nrow(expand.grid(model = models_ssp, ssp = qed_ssp_list,
                                  var = qed_vars))
   cat("Agg files written:", nrow(combos_made), "of", n_expected, "expected\n")
   missing <- data.table::setdiff(
      data.table::expand.grid(model = models_ssp, ssp = qed_ssp_list,
                              var = qed_vars, stringsAsFactors = TRUE),
      combos_made)
   if (nrow(missing)) {
      cat("MISSING (logged in QED_40_ssp_exclusions.csv and",
          "qed_40_combo_status.csv):\n")
      print(utils::head(missing, 20))
   }
   stopifnot(nrow(combos_made) > 0)   # never wipe outputs on a parse mistake
}
qed_log(sprintf("QED_40 done: %d agg files on disk", length(made)),
        qed_ssp_log_file)
```

**Handoff contract for `QED_50_ssp_apply.Rmd`:** read these agg files with
`qed_read_agg()` (layout is identical to the historical aggs), fit EQM per
catchment x variable on the historical 1981-2014 pair (observed reference vs
`agg_<var>_<model>.csv` from QED_05), apply to each SSP series with
`qed_extrap_pr <- "linear"`, `qed_extrap_temp <- "linear"`, and carry the
`within_range` / `extrapolated_low` / `extrapolated_high` flags through
unchanged. NAs here mean: window gap (2061-2080), Feb-29 of noleap models,
or 360-day-calendar invalid dates -- downstream modules must count them in
`n_gap_filled`, never fill silently.
